findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_paid_endpoints, get_full_signal, get_rwa_feed, get_kraken_listings, get_crypto_rules, check_spend_policy, check_seller_reputation, should_i_pay · Private data: buy_day_pass, get_token_verdict, get_rwa_feed, check_seller_reputation · Public sink: get_full_signal, subscribe_green_dot_alerts, buy_day_pass, get_history, check_spend_policy, check_seller_reputation, should_i_pay · Destructive: check_spend_policy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_paid_endpoints, get_full_signal, get_rwa_feed, get_kraken_listings, get_crypto_rules, check_spend_policy, check_seller_reputation, should_i_pay · Private data: buy_day_pass, get_token_verdict, get_rwa_feed, check_seller_reputation · Public sink: get_full_signal, subscribe_green_dot_alerts, buy_day_pass, get_history, check_spend_policy, check_seller_reputation, should_i_pay · Destructive: check_spend_policy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
